body:
## Summary
- Accept CRLF adapter manifests on Windows checkouts while retaining rejection of embedded carriage returns and malformed values.
- Verify Hermes fetched skill trees against the expected source while tolerating Markdown CRLF/LF checkout conversion; preserve exact matching, rejection, and rollback behavior.
- Mark physical-symlink-only installer checks pending on hosts where `ln -s` does not create a symlink.

## Verification
- Independent QA: PASS on tree `d9393eee25e67a8abf04373a296b6b828da7e756`.
- Security review: PASS; no findings on the same tree.
- Linux installer matrix, CRLF OpenCode wrapper, malformed-manifest cases, rollback, source mismatch, doc counts, and release-ledger checks passed.
- Windows terminal wrapper and repository-wide hosted CI remain pending; hosted CI will run on this PR.

This fixes two public-install failures found by downloading and testing the merged v0.9.5 candidate from GitHub.
title: fix(install): handle Windows CRLF checkouts for v0.9.5
